purpose: Teach: 包み/吐い/おとなしく/しあわせ/ややこしい/蚊/いじっ/となり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お母さんからの包み、お弁当、入ってたよ、嬉しかったよ、今朝。
lines.en: Riku — my mom sent me a package this morning with a homemade lunch inside. I was really happy about it.
lines.style: Warm, genuine opening. Quick pace, easy rhythm. Small lift on the mention of the lunch. Not performing happiness — just naturally pleased, like sharing something small that mattered.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。先輩、合宿で、酔って、吐いてしまったらしいぜ、桜、聞いた?
lines.en: Yeah. Hey, did you hear — apparently our senpai got drunk at the camp and threw up.
lines.style: Light, conspiratorial half-laugh underneath. Casual topic-shift. The wry amusement of someone sharing gossip he doesn't quite believe. Rapid, almost offhand delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、いつも、おとなしく、授業を、受けてるよね、まじめだね、リク。
lines.en: You know, you're always so quiet in class, so serious about everything. It's kind of impressive, actually.
lines.style: Softer underneath the words. A genuine compliment wrapped in casual observation. Slight hesitation before 'impressive' — checking herself for being too sincere. Warm eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と一緒にいる時、結構、しあわせ感じるんだぜ、俺、桜。
lines.en: When I'm with you, I actually feel... kind of happy, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, vulnerable admission. The breath before the confession. Slower pace, each word given weight. Slight catch or exhale on 'happy.' Mortified but committed to finishing the sentence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 数学のテスト、ややこしい問題、出てきて、頭、痛かったよ、最後の方。
lines.en: The math test had all these impossible questions, and by the end my brain was completely fried.
lines.style: Wry exhale on the opening. Slight laugh-line underneath. Building frustration through the middle, then trailing off with tired resignation. The tone of someone venting to a friend who gets it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夏の合宿、蚊が、すごく多いから、ちゃんと、対策しような、桜。
lines.en: Summer camp's going to be crawling with mosquitoes. Make sure you actually bring bug spray this time, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Practical concern masked as gentle directive. Not fussing — just quietly looking out. Slightly warmer on her name at the end. The tone of someone who's already thought this through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 宿題、PCをいじってると、ついSNSばかり、見ちゃうわよね、私も。
lines.en: I keep telling myself I'll focus on homework, but the second I open my laptop I end up just scrolling through social media instead. Same problem, honestly.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, almost rueful. Slower pace, like admitting something she's already given up on. Slight laugh at her own weakness. Relatable confession, not complaint.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の家のとなり、新しい家族、引っ越してきたって、聞いたぜ。
lines.en: Oh, by the way — I heard a new family just moved in next door to your place.
lines.style: Casual opening, genuine curiosity underneath. Leaning-in tone without being prying. Testing the waters — checking if he knows and what he thinks. Warm, interested.
